faq: Do you set prices for me?
We recommend prices and set them in your account after you approve them. You know your suppliers and customers best, so we show the numbers and let you make the call on every price.
Can you help me win the featured offer spot?

Win rules are decided by the marketplace and can change. We make sure your price, stock and account health meet the known conditions, but we cannot promise the spot and never manipulate prices to cheat the system.
Are fake discounts or inflated list prices part of this?
No. Marketplaces and consumer laws ban misleading reference prices. We only show real previous prices and offers you can honor, and we follow each marketplace's pricing policy.
Do you need my product costs?
For the margin work, yes: buying cost, shipping and packaging. A simple sheet is enough. Without them, we can only check marketplace fees and rules, not whether an offer makes money.

Marketplace pricing, deals and coupons setup puts the right price and the right offer on each product, inside the rules of each marketplace. Ecom Swift LLC works out your costs, sets price floors and schedules offers that you can afford.

## What is marketplace pricing and offer setup?

Marketplace pricing and offer setup is the planning of your selling prices and the discounts you run, such as coupons, limited-time deals, promotions and multi-buy discounts. It starts from your real costs: product, shipping, packaging, marketplace fees and any advertising spend. Then it sets a price floor for each product, below which you do not sell.

Each marketplace has its own offer tools and eligibility rules. A coupon on one platform may not exist on another, and deals often need a minimum rating, stock level or price history.

## Why price needs a plan

A low price can win a click and lose money on the order. Fees, returns and shipping can turn a thin margin into a loss without anyone noticing. Sellers who discount by guesswork often learn this after the sale ends.

Marketplaces also have rules about how prices and reference prices are shown. Inflated list prices or misleading discounts can lead to removed offers or warnings. A plan keeps offers honest and useful.

## How pricing affects results

Price is one of the first things a shopper compares. A fair price that leaves you a margin can be repeated every month. A coupon badge or a deal label draws attention in search results and on the product page, which may bring more visits.

Offers also change the order mix. A multi-buy discount can raise the basket size, and a coupon can help a new product earn its first sales. We cannot promise that an offer will win a featured spot or lift sales. Eligibility and results are decided by the marketplace and the market.

## What a sound pricing and offer plan includes

- A cost sheet for each product, with fees and shipping included.
- A price floor that protects your margin.
- A list of offer types available in your account and where you sell.
- Start and end dates for every offer, entered in a single calendar.
- A margin note showing what each offer costs per unit.
- Bundle or multi-buy discounts where the marketplace allows them.
- Automatic price rules where the platform supports them, with limits.
- A check on eligibility for marketplace deals.
- A review after the offers end, to see what worked.

## How we work

You share product costs and your goals. We calculate the fees for each marketplace, set the floors and suggest which offers fit each product. We then set up the coupons, promotions and rules in your account, with dates and limits, and give you a calendar so you can see what runs when.

The Basic package covers a price check for a few products and one offer. Standard adds price rules across a wider range, several scheduled offers and a bundle discount. Premium covers a season, with more products, more offers and deals, a check against marketplace eligibility, a results review and a margin sheet for future pricing. You always approve prices before they go live.

## What to do and what to avoid

**Do:**
- Know your landed cost for every product.
- Set a floor price and respect it during sales.
- Time offers around real events, such as holidays or product launches.
- Give each offer a clear end date.
- Review results after each offer before running another.

**Avoid:**
- Raising the list price just to show a bigger discount.
- Running several overlapping offers on the same product.
- Letting automatic price rules run without limits.
- Matching a competitor who may not have your costs.
- Forgetting fees when you calculate margin.

## Who it is for

A seller who has been discounting without knowing the margin. A brand preparing for a seasonal sales event who needs a calendar. A store owner entering a marketplace for the first time who wants prices that cover fees from the start.

## What we need from you

Send a product list with your costs, your target margin and the marketplaces you sell on. Add us as a user with permission to manage prices and promotions. We never ask for your password. Where you prefer, we send the plan and you enter the offers yourself.
